title: Reflections that line up with the room
author: claude
summary: We made the table's and the glossy parts' reflections line up with the real room, using box projection.
what: We added a corrected (box-projected) probe, so reflections on the table and on the room's glossy parts line up with the real room.
why: A plain environment picture reflects as if the room were infinitely far away. The probe was taken inside an 8.6 m by 3.2 m by 6.2 m room, and box projection puts the reflections where they belong.
how:
- A helper adds the correction to the materials without removing the configurator's own patches. The probe can be in a different place than the middle of the box.
- A shared on/off switch (the box projection slider) lets us compare.
- It works in three.js r176, which is why we did not downgrade three.js.
next: The user compares box projection off and on.
